sourceTitle: Quinoa Salad with Mango, Sprouts, Nuts and Berries
sourceText:
Quinoa Salad with Mango, Sprouts, Nuts and Berries
By: Matt
Published: Monday, October 23, 2017 - 3:31am

Ingredients




For the Salad
1⁄2 cup cooked kidney beans
3 tbsps dried goji berries
1 mango (diced)
1 medium red bell pepper (sliced)
3 1⁄2 oz salad greens
1 3⁄4 oz seed sprouts
1⁄2 cup sweet corn
1 oz walnut halves (crushed)
For the quinoa
1⁄2 cup quinoa
1 cup water

Preparation

1 Boil the quinoa in water until soft for 20 minutes. 2 Mix the quinoa with the goji berries, kidney beans, sweet corn, walnut halves and the salad dressing. 3 Put the salad greens, bean sprouts and bell pepper on a plate or a bowl and add the rest of the ingredients.
